Ops-Bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT — High 5xx rate on runtime-pool-a (us-west-2). Auto-scaling healthy but p95 latency climbing. Trigger: 5xx spike from gateway. Pager: @eng-oncall

Lina R.: ack, seeing it. Jumping in now.

Tom B.: I can look at ingress/gateway errors. Lina, can you check runtime-1 queues?

Lina R.: checking KV cache / in-flight queues. Quick grep shows a bunch of "QUEUE_FULL" from runtime-1 -> looks like backpressure. Also seeing client burst from key `client:acme-marketing`.

Rajesh P.: tagging metrics:
```
# grafana query (approx)
sum(rate(runtime_requests_total{job="runtime",status=~"5.."}[1m])) by (pool)
```
spike at 12:02 -> sustained till now.

Tom B.: gateway logs show many long tail latencies + upstream 503s. Suspecting queue saturation + low timeouts hitting.

Lina R.: mitigation plan (short-lived):
- apply runtime backpressure: lower max-in-flight on runtime-pool-a to reduce queue depth
- enable shedding for non-critical routes (summarize, rerank)
- increase upstream timeouts slightly to avoid cascaded cancels
- rate-limit offending client key `acme-marketing` to 10r/s as emergency throttle
- if still bad, disable streaming on the public endpoint

Tom B.: agreed. I'll make gateway changes. Lina, do the runtime config. Rajesh, can you run impact query for top clients?

Rajesh P.: running quick aggregation:
```
# top clients by error rate
topk(5, sum by (client_key)(rate(runtime_request_errors_total[2m])))
```
Result: `acme-marketing` ~42% of errors, `internal-ml` ~8%, others <5%.

Lina R.: reducing max-in-flight via runtime admin API now:
```
curl -X POST https://runtime-admin.internal/pool/runtime-pool-a/config -d '{"max_in_flight":150}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```
Response: 200 OK, applied.

Ops-Bot: CONFIG CHANGE recorded by Lina R. at 1769543340.

Tom B.: applied temporary gateway rate-limit for acme-marketing:
```
# envoy rate-limit (applied)
PATCH /configs/gateway/ratelimit
{ "key": "client:acme-marketing", "limit": "10r/s" }
```
Gateway accepted.

Lina R.: enabled shedding for low-priority routes (rerank & summarizer):
```
# runtime feature flags
PUT /flags/runtime-pool-a
{ "shed_low_priority": true }
```
Confirmed. Dropped non-critical queue pressure ~30%.

Tom B.: also increased upstream timeout from 5s -> 8s to avoid premature cancellations on slow KV reads. Deployed to canary, then rolled to all.

Marta C. (Customer Success): quick heads-up — acme-marketing is likely getting 429s until mitigation stabilizes. CS alerted them and opened an incident ticket.

Rajesh P.: monitoring: errors dropped from ~18% to ~7% in last 90s after config changes. p95 latency trending down but still above baseline.

Lina R.: follow-ups:
- keep rate-limit on acme-marketing for 30m then reassess (we'll bump gradually if stable)
- run a targeted replay on staging to reproduce queue behavior with their traffic pattern
- add an automated shedding rule to run when queue depth > 70% for >1m

Tom B.: document of commands used (for postmortem):
```
# runtime admin
curl ... '/config' -> set max_in_flight to 150
# gateway
PATCH /configs/gateway/ratelimit -> client:acme-marketing 10r/s
# feature flag
PUT /flags/runtime-pool-a -> shed_low_priority:true
```

Lina R.: Current customer impact (rough):
- acme-marketing: 15-25% request failures / 429s observed during throttle window
- other customers: brief increase in latency, error rates returned to ~baseline after 2-3 minutes

Sahil K.: I'm taking watch to observe for 30m. Lina, if it looks unstable after that, I'll escalate to infra oncall to consider adding capacity or temporary fallback model.

Lina R.: handing off context to @Sahil K. — all active mitigations documented above. Logs and dashboard links: https://grafana.internal/d/runtime-pool-a (private link)

Ops-Bot: NOTE: On-call handoff recorded. Next check-in due in 20 minutes.

Sahil K.: acknowledged. I'll post updates in this thread.

Tom B.: one more thing — we should avoid permanent lowering of max-in-flight; this is an emergency throttle. Add follow-up action to revert to baseline (500) once stable.

Marta C.: CS updated customer ticket: "We're throttling to protect platform stability; we'll coordinate a better rate plan and replay."

Lina R.: timeline:
- 1769543210 alert fired
- 1769543340 max-in-flight lowered + shedding enabled + rate-limit applied
- 1769543470 p95 trending down, errors reduced
- 1769543899 handing to Sahil for 30m watch

Sahil K.: FYI — if we see queue depth re-cross 70% for >2m, plan is:
1) escalate to infra to spin additional pool (if autoscaling can't keep up)
2) temporarily disable streaming & non-blocking features entirely
3) contact top offending clients for coordinated backoff

Lina R.: added follow-up ticket: INFRA-1329 tracking replay, autotune rules, and revert checklist.

Tom B.: thanks team. Good coordination. I'll compile the notes for the postmortem template.

Marta C.: keeping CS looped. Will push updates to the customer and mark severity.

Ops-Bot: INCIDENT STATUS -> mitigated (partial). Continued monitoring by Sahil K.

Sahil K.: 10m into watch — metrics look stable, error rate holding ~6-7%. Will report back at +30m or earlier if regress.

Lina R.: great. If anything else pops, ping here or call my cell.
